scares.description: Sarah runs into Beth at the hospital.
A metal rod smashes through the window during one of Sarah’s dreams.
A large number of bats fly out in front of the girls.
Juno jumps down in front of Sarah.
Sarah turns around and Juno is right behind her.
A crawler is seen standing behind the group through the night vision camera.
The girls run into a crawler that screams at them.
Sarah hallucinates her daughter, however when her head turns she becomes one of the creatures from the cave.
Holly’s body is dropped in front of Sarah, the creatures then proceed to eat the body.
A crawler drops down from the roof in front of Rebecca.
Beth sticks her hand in the air and calls for Sarah.
A baby crawler jumps on Sarah’s back.
Sam sees a crawler moving along the cave roof.
Juno spots a crawler while underwater  it growls at Juno.
Juno appears in the car beside Sarah.
